title: Khans of Tarkir: card flavor text

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker (character) who is thought of by the shaman Chianul when a kirin appears, and who returns to Tarkir.

entities.name: Chianul
entities.description: A Temur shaman who thought of Sarkhan Vol when a kirin appeared, and who speaks of dragons and dreams.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan, who holds court under the First Tree and leads the Abzan Houses to battle.

entities.name: Zogye
entities.description: A wandering sage.

entities.name: Kadri
entities.description: An Abzan caravan master.

entities.name: Golran
entities.description: A dragonscale captain of the Abzan.

entities.name: Khibat the Revered
entities.description: A speaker who says the dragons thought themselves too strong to be tamed.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: A krumar commander.

entities.name: Chanyi
entities.description: A mistfire sage.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Khan of the Jeskai.

entities.name: Arel the Whisperer
entities.description: A Temur character who dreamed of winter's end, found a seedling in the snow, and was woven as a whisperer by Chianul.

entities.name: Ulnok
entities.description: A Temur shaman.

entities.name: Nitula
entities.description: The Hunt Caller of the Temur.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: Khan of the Sultai, who answered an envoy and keeps Taigam as her Hand.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Sidisi's Hand, a Sultai who once left the Jeskai for a people unafraid of true power.

entities.name: Urdnan the Wanderer
entities.description: A speaker who compares bats to falcons.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Khan of the Mardu, a foe of Sarkhan Vol.

entities.name: Kirada
entities.description: A Qarsi overseer of the Sultai.

entities.name: Taklai
entities.description: A Mardu ragesinger.

entities.name: Kerai Suddenblade
entities.description: A Mardu hordechief.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: Khan of the Temur, whose rank and scars were earned in single combat against a cave bear.

entities.name: Asmala
entities.description: A bloodfire mystic.

entities.name: Mogai
entities.description: A Sultai scout.

entities.name: Shintan
entities.description: A fighter who sensed malice in an orc opponent.

entities.name: Shensu
entities.description: A Riverwheel mystic.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker (character) who addresses Ugin as entombed.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon, said to lie in a tomb and whose fall is witnessed in Tarkir's history.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir led by Anafenza.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir following the Jeskai Way, led by Narset.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir of warrior hordes, led by Zurgo.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir of necromancers ruled by Sidisi.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir led by Surrak.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the khans and clans live and where dragons are extinct.

entities.name: Mer-Ek
entities.description: The Abzan stronghold whose gates are sealed when Anafenza holds court.

entities.name: First Tree
entities.description: The tree under which Anafenza holds court.

entities.name: Sage-Eye Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold.

entities.name: Riverwheel Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold.

entities.name: Qarsi Palace
entities.description: A palace in the jungle of the Sultai.

events.summary: Word of kirin sightings spreads and all the khans take it to mean themselves, but only Chianul thinks of Sarkhan Vol.
events.quote: Only the shaman Chianul thought of Sarkhan Vol.

events.summary: Anafenza holds court under the First Tree while the gates of Mer-Ek are sealed.
events.quote: When Anafenza holds court under the First Tree, the gates of Mer-Ek are sealed.

events.summary: Arel dreams of winter's end and finds a seedling in the snow.
An envoy speaks and Sidisi replies.
events.quote: The envoy spoke, and Sidisi replied.

events.summary: Sorin Markov taunts the entombed Ugin.
Zurgo confronts Sarkhan Vol, calling him a traitor returned from fire.
events.quote: You have returned from fire, traitor.

events.summary: Zurgo tells Sarkhan that he made a legend from what Sarkhan abandoned.
events.quote: I made a legend from what you abandoned.

events.summary: Chianul attends the weaving of Arel.
Sarkhan's mind falls silent at Ugin's Nexus.
events.quote: All at once Sarkhan's mind fell silent.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol visits the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon, finding only bones.
events.quote: The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones.

relations.quote: Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment.
If weakness does not exist within the Temur then we shall force it upon them.
We have a word for enemies too mutilated for military service: furniture.
People are often humbled by the elements.

relations.note: calls him a traitor and vows to see him leave as ashes
relations.quote: This time I will see you leave as ashes.

relations.note: Sidisi plans to force weakness upon the Temur
relations.quote: If weakness does not exist within the Temur then we shall force it upon them.
